about.badge: Rooted in Indian Agriculture • Companion for Every Farmer
about.title: About KhetSaathi
about.desc: KhetSaathi is an intelligent agricultural decision support platform designed to help farmers make data-backed choices using weather data, regional soil intelligence, and computer vision.
about.missionDesc: To simplify modern farming by delivering clear, honest, and actionable agronomy insights directly to every Indian farmer—enabling higher crop yields, reduced chemical waste, and sustained soil health.
about.visionDesc: To build a resilient agricultural ecosystem across India where micro-climate weather forecasts, ICAR regional soil cards, and machine learning empower farmers to farm with confidence and profitability.

schemesPreview.title: Government Schemes & Subsidies
schemesPreview.desc: KhetSaathi helps farmers discover relevant Central and State Government agricultural subsidies, financial support programs, and insurance schemes matched to their state, land size, and crops.
schemesPreview.autoMatch: Automatically matched when you log into the platform.

dashboard.subtitle: Welcome to your KhetSaathi AI Agronomy Assistant.
dashboard.choicesTitle: How can KhetSaathi help you today?
dashboard.choicesSubtitle: Select one of the two core services below to get started.
dashboard.option1Subtitle: Diagnose plant health and receive treatment recommendations.
dashboard.option2Subtitle: Plan crops, improve soil health and receive seasonal farming guidance.

plantCare.heroDesc: Suitable for home gardens, nursery plants, trees, and agricultural crops. Upload 1 to 10 clear photos from different angles for AI diagnosis.
plantCare.guidanceTip: For better accuracy, upload multiple clear images of the same plant from different angles (leaf, stem, fruit, or affected area).
plantCare.dragDropTitle: Drag & Drop crop leaf photos here
plantCare.dragDropSubtitle: or click to browse from gallery (JPEG, PNG up to 10MB)
plantCare.awaitingDesc: Upload or capture photos of your plant leaf or stem. The system will validate image quality and render diagnosis & remedies.

soil.heroDesc: Select your state, soil type, and farming season to receive ICAR-backed NPK nutrient balances, organic carbon status, and soil conditioning advice.

weather.heroDesc: Real-time hyper-local temperature, humidity, rainfall probability, and wind velocity with practical daily farming advice.

schemes.heroDesc: Official Central and State Government schemes matched to your state, land holding, and crop choices.

cropAdvisor.heroDesc: AI-recommended crops matched to your regional soil type, climate, rainfall forecast, and expected market demand.

fertilizer.heroDesc: Calculate exact fertilizer dosage for basal and top-dressing applications based on crop stage and soil fertility.

locationModal.title: Allow Location Access
locationModal.subtitle: Saathi Smart Geo-Intelligence
locationModal.desc: KhetSaathi uses your location only after you log in or continue as guest. Your location is used to automatically fetch weather, humidity, rainfall, district, state and farming recommendations.
locationModal.check2: Live Weather, Temp, Humidity %, Rainfall & Wind

guestModal.check1: Instant reactive language switching (EN / HI / MR)
guestModal.check2: Interactive harvest yield & water savings calculator
guestModal.check3: Full bento grid exploration of 6 AI tools
